Canonical URL: https://remiclassic.github.io/remiresume/

Name: Guillaume (Remi) Couture
Also known as: Remi Couture, Guillaume Couture, Rémi Couture
Location: Greater Montreal, Canada (works remotely worldwide)

What he does:
- Principal craft: UX/UI and product design for games and products
- Specialties: Unreal Engine UMG and CommonUI, UI motion, front‑end build (React, TypeScript)
- End‑to‑end: strategy, user flows, visual design, animation specs, in‑engine and front‑end implementation

Experience and credits (selected, as shown on the site):
- Studios/clients: Disney, Sony, Riot Games, AppLovin, Tencent, Phoenix Labs, Universal, Hasbro, Twitch, Piranha Games, Frima, DeNA, Cupcake Digital, Gogii Games
- Roles: Senior UX/UI Designer, UX Director, Lead UX/UI, UX/UI Instructor, Consultant
- Nearly two decades of shipped work across PC, console, mobile, VR and web

Independent studio and tools:
- Founder of Strategic Sloth LLC (https://www.strategicsloth.com/)
- Creator of Focusrail, an Unreal Engine UI navigation tool (see strategicsloth.com/focusrail/ and the Fab listing)
- SliceForge: game UI production tool (https://www.sliceforge.io/)
- Games: Tropic Tumble (Google Play), Runefjord (in testing), Sloth Jam (https://www.slothjam.com)
